**Regulation to analyze:** FSMA Intentional Adulteration rule (food defense), 21 CFR Part 121
**Why:** The only binding, sector-specific federal security rule for food facilities; its vulnerability-assessment/mitigation structure maps well to cyber-physical risks (e.g., tampering via compromised batching/dosing controls). Pair with NIST CSF 2.0 for IT/OT control coverage since Part 121 is not IT-specific.
